name: recordly-codex
description: Codex Desktop Browser capture and editable local projects for approved evidence-backed website recordings.

interface.shortDescription: Capture, edit, and render approved browser recordings.
interface.longDescription: Guides Codex Desktop Browser through approved evidence-backed capture, then creates versioned editable projects with deterministic MP4/GIF rendering, source-timed composition, and fail-closed revision and media-integrity gates.
capabilities: Automatic broker-timed trusted-click and trusted-wheel-derived scroll evidence
Trims, speed ramps, transitions, cursor, click, zoom, overlays, PiP, and audio
defaultPrompt: Record this approved URL and objective with Recordly Codex.
Create a local browser recording session for this approved workflow.
Inspect this recording session and report its safe capture state.
Seal this completed capture and return its quality-approved delivery artifacts.
Create an editable project from this approved capture and render a preview.
